sql: SELECT DISTINCT publication_date FROM ag.ers_farm_income WHERE state='US' AND "year"=2026 ORDER BY 1
SELECT DISTINCT category, subcategory, variable_description_total FROM ag.ers_farm_income WHERE state='US' AND category ILIKE '%net farm income%'
SELECT DISTINCT category FROM ag.ers_farm_income WHERE state='US' ORDER BY 1
SELECT "year", subcategory, amount, unit_desc FROM ag.ers_farm_income WHERE state='US' AND category='Net income' AND "year">=2023 ORDER BY subcategory, "year"
SELECT "year", subcategory, amount, unit_desc FROM ag.ers_farm_income WHERE state='US' AND category='Government payments' AND "year">=2023 ORDER BY subcategory, "year"
SELECT "year", subcategory, amount, unit_desc FROM ag.ers_farm_income WHERE state='US' AND category='Production expenses' AND "year">=2023 ORDER BY subcategory, "year"
SELECT "year", subcategory, amount, type, artificial_key FROM ag.ers_farm_income WHERE state='US' AND category='Production expenses' AND subcategory='All' AND "year" IN (2025,2026) ORDER BY "year"
SELECT "year", type, amount FROM ag.ers_farm_income WHERE state='US' AND category='Net income' AND subcategory='Farm income' AND "year">=2023 ORDER BY "year"
SELECT "year", amount, gdp_deflator FROM ag.ers_farm_income WHERE state='US' AND category='Net income' AND subcategory='Farm income' AND "year" IN (2025,2026)
